current.note: Evidence › Sources lists ten sources by state (Current, Overdue, Import failed) and check; nothing says what a source evidences, and a missing source is not listed.

changes.title: Each source says what it evidences
changes.text: An Evidences column counts the objectives and controls of WS-X90's baseline each source can evidence (ACAS: 46 objectives · 10 controls). One line above sums the connected sources: 185 of 1,791 objectives.
changes.drata: A connection's card and its Benefits rail count the impact areas, controls and tests it feeds, before and after connecting.

changes.title: A missing source reads Not connected
changes.text: Two sources the baseline needs and lacks are rows of their own: the Configuration Repository's inventory export and the program office's Jira change tickets. Each reads Not connected with the count it would evidence; connecting both adds 29 objectives.
changes.drata: The Available tab lists connections not made yet beside the active ones, each card saying what it covers.

changes.title: Health names the step that failed
changes.text: Health is one word: Healthy, Overdue (past its cadence), or Error with the step that failed (the telemetry SARIF scan: Error at Validate). Problems sort first; Kind and Health are filters in the one toolbar row, with saved views.
changes.drata: Connections carry an operational status, Healthy or Unhealthy, filterable beside the category of each connection.

current.note: A preview only: state, kind, last imported, cadence, its check, owner, "Informs 11 controls" as plain text, and the list of imports.

changes.title: A page with the one header
changes.text: The source gets its own page: the trail, the title, ⋯ then Import file as the one primary, a facts strip (Health, Kind, Last run, Cadence, Tool, Owner with a pencil) and line tabs, Matching with a pale red 9.
changes.drata: A connection's page puts Status and the account's details in a facts row under its name, with Overview and Manage tabs.

changes.title: Evidences: every number opens its list
changes.text: "46 objectives · 10 controls · 16 components": the first two open the controls with their objective counts, the third the matched hosts. Under them the ten controls as status chips, and how many objectives have evidence today.
changes.drata: The Benefits rail counts impact areas, controls and tests, and each count expands into its list.

changes.title: Sync steps, each with its state
changes.text: Collect, Validate, Match assets, Apply, each Done, Running, Failed or Waiting; a failed step carries the tool's own reason (SARIF validation failed at runs[0].results[17]). What it last brought in sits beside: 1,284 results across 26 hosts.
changes.drata: Sync status lists each synced object with its state, and an unhealthy connection explains the failure.

changes.title: The body in the grey well
changes.text: Overview's four cards (Evidences, Sync, Scope and matching, Last brought in) are white raised cards in the sunken well; the register stays one surface.
changes.drata: Record pages sit in a grey well with white bordered cards; lists stay flat.

current.note: The boundary is a picture of the components each authorization covers; nothing decides which scanned hosts count, so every host ACAS reached counts.

changes.title: The boundary written as rules
changes.text: Enclave rules first (mission network and ground support LAN in; depot enclave and test bench out), then tag and name rules, each In or Out; the last match decides. Each rule says how many hosts it reaches.
changes.drata: Resource scoping picks all or specific resources, in or out of scope, through condition groups of tag and name conditions.

changes.title: A live count as rules change
changes.text: In scope 26 · Out of scope 4 · Rules 5, redrawn on every change; once rules are applied, the difference from them; beside it, every host the scan reached with In or Out.
changes.drata: The scoping card shows how many people the chosen groups bring in, as a count of the whole.

changes.title: Apply shows the counts first
changes.text: Apply scope opens a review in place: hosts in WS-X90's enclaves (locked), left out, "Moving 26 · Not moving 4", and the consequence: findings on the 4 stop counting toward WS-X90. Then Apply scope or Back to rules.
changes.drata: A command over many records opens a confirmation that counts what it will create, update or leave alone before it runs.

current.note: The component inventory lists what is inside the boundary; scanned hosts are never compared with it, so CM-8 cannot tell a host nobody inventoried.

changes.title: Not matched, with a picker in the cell
changes.text: ACAS's 26 in-scope hosts against the component inventory: 17 match by their LRU name; the 9 that don't have a red edge, "Not matched", and a component picker in the Component cell. Your match can be undone.
changes.drata: Unlinked rows carry a red edge and Not linked, with Link personnel or a device dropdown right in the row.

changes.title: One line names the consequence
changes.text: Above the table, one warning line: "9 hosts not matched · CM-8 objective 1 stays unevidenced". It is words, not a tinted banner, and it falls with each match.
changes.drata: A banner names the test that will fail while devices or accounts stay unlinked.

current.note: The team lists people and the roles they hold; no account from any directory is compared with it.

changes.title: Accounts matched to people for AC-2
changes.text: The identity provider's WS-X90 accounts against the program's people: 12 match, 3 don't (kchen, jlee.adm, mx-shared01), each with a person picker. The line reads "3 accounts not matched · AC-02a.[01] stays unevidenced".
changes.drata: Accounts from each identity source are linked to personnel; an unlinked account is flagged where it stands.

changes.title: A deleted account stays, revoked
changes.text: hwalsh, deleted at the source, stays in the list as "Access revoked · Oct 28", so the AC-2 review can show when access ended.
changes.drata: Accounts keep an Access revoked date column after the source deletes them.

changes.title: Directory groups decide the scope
changes.text: The same rules over directory groups: the three ws-x90 groups in, depot-maintenance-users and service accounts out, so 4 depot accounts never count.
changes.drata: Personnel scoping picks the identity provider's groups that a workspace counts.

current.note: The switch's checklists: a preview with state, cadence and imports; nothing says which host it read, which component it counts for, or which rules

changes.title: Every source has the same tabs
changes.text: A STIG checklist, an SBOM and a container scan now open on Overview, Scope, Matching and Runs, as ACAS and the identity source do; a source not connected says so on each.
changes.drata: Every connection opens on the same tabs, whatever it connects.

changes.title: Scope: its component and its rules
changes.text: The switch's scope is one component and the rules of its two STIGs: 65 rules, 4 not applicable, 61 in scope, 6 open, from V3's checklists, each a link to its checklist.
changes.drata: Scoping says which resources a connection counts, with live counts.

changes.title: Matching: the host it ran on
changes.text: Matching shows the host the checklist ran on, lru-009-esw at 10.20.3.31, matched to the Internal Ethernet Switch by the checklist's asset.
changes.drata: Each resource a connection reads is linked to a person or an asset, with its link state.

current.note: Import file adds a row that stays queued; ACAS's November import reads Importing for days

changes.title: A run moves, then finishes
changes.text: Import file, Run now and Connect queue a run that reads Queued, then Running while the sync steps light one by one, then Done within four seconds.
changes.drata: A sync shows its state while it runs and its result when it is done.

changes.title: Counts from the last run
changes.text: A finished run reads what V3 holds for the source (the gateway: 139 rules, 11 open); Last run, Health and the register update, and its checklists' evidence renews.
changes.drata: A connection's last sync and health update when a sync finishes.

changes.title: It holds across pages
changes.text: A run's state follows from when it was asked, kept in the session, so leaving the page and coming back shows it done, and the register updates while open.
changes.drata: Syncs run in the background while the user works elsewhere.

Source record Overview and Scope: white cards in the grey well
Register: the eye opens a walkable source preview
Source record: the controls it evidences as status chips

derived: Source kinds (scanner, STIG checklist, inventory, ticketing, identity): from each V3 source's file kind; SBOMs read as inventory.

The controls each source can evidence: chosen from what its tool reads (ACAS: RA-5, SI-2, SI-3, CM-8 and enhancements; STIG and SCAP: CM-6, CM-7, CM-2, IA-5, AU-12), kept to those WS-X90's baseline selects. Objective counts are the SSP's own (ob per control).
Health: from V3's imports (Error when the latest import failed or was rejected after the last applied one; Overdue when the last applied import is older than its check's cadence).
Sync steps (Upload or Collect, Validate, Match, Apply) and their states: from the latest import's state.

The identity source (Corporate identity provider, WS-X90 accounts): the enterprise service WS-X90 lists as a provider; its 21 accounts are the program's people by username, three with no person, one deleted Oct 28 (hwalsh) and five outside the scope (four depot, one service account); daily runs.
The two not-connected sources (Configuration Repository inventory export; Jira change tickets): CM-8/CM-2 and CM-3/CM-4/CM-5, which the baseline selects and no source feeds.

ACAS's 30 hosts: one per hardware component of the inventory, named for its LRU (17 match by name), plus 9 in the boundary's enclaves it does not match (a second gateway unit, a second switch, a second workstation, a laptop, a log collector VM, the repository host, two named differently, one bare address) and 4 outside (depot enclave, test bench). Addresses and enclaves are derived.
Scope rules: written from the boundary (inside enclaves in, outside out); ACAS's are a draft not yet applied, the identity source's applied when it was connected.
The objective a matching gap holds back: the control's first assessment objective (CM-8's, AC-2's AC-02a.[01]).
Last sign-in of each account: a fixed offset from today by its name.

A checklist source's host: the scanner's host for its component's LRU (lru-001-mc, lru-009-esw, lru-007-pngw, lru-019-mlt); SBOM and container images named for their component; its rules and their counts are V3's checklists, read through lane B.

A STIG source's cadence: its checklists' own next import as V3 schedules it (RHEL 9, switch and gateway 90 days, ASD 180, Windows 11 30), so a source and its checklist evidence agree; it was 30 days for all.

Run timing: Queued for 1.5 s, Running until 4 s, then Done, from the moment it was asked (kept in the session). A run reads the source's last applied import from V3; a source that never ran reads, for the inventory export, V3's component inventory, and for Jira no count.
A V3 import still pending (ACAS's November scan, the switch's queued checklist, the PIC's SBOM) is taken over by a run asked here, which finishes it.
conflicts: Drata's red Unhealthy and Not linked chips and its warning banner meet "no tinted banners" and "one tone a status": the consequence is one line of warning words above the table, an unmatched row has a thin red edge, and Health is one word with one tone.
Drata's Benefits rail of three cards with icons meets "numbers over prose" and calm: it became one line of linked counts (D.worth) with the controls as chips under it.
Drata's connections gallery splits Active and Available into tabs: a list's kinds are filters, so Not connected is a Health value and a saved view in the one toolbar row, never a tab.
Drata's AI sync-failure summary: no AI here; the failed step carries the tool's own error text.
